en: Looks like we're comin' up on the end,{SAUT}guys!
About time... So this is our Easter egg,{SAUT}huh!?{PAGE}...Wait, what?
It's just a picture.{OPTION}It's... technically an egg.
That's all!? What about my million{SAUT}yen...?
Ahaha, that's a bit of a letdown, but{SAUT}it's not all bad, right?{PAGE}Trying to find it was kinda fun. It was{SAUT}like a game.
I think, now, I have a better idea of what{SAUT}Easter was like for you, Panther.
Hmm, I guess video games aren't the{SAUT}only kinds of games out there.{PAGE}I'll need to familiarize myself with the{SAUT}other, more participatory types too.
Y-You think if we do it a second time,{SAUT}a secret boss will show up and drop the{SAUT}real treasure...? Maybe?
Give it up, Junpei. The game's over...
